title: AI Acceptance Criteria: Tell AI When It's Done
description:
Tell AI when it's done, or it will guess! ✅

✅ Add a "Done when:" list to your prompt
✅ Write one checkable example per line
✅ Run pytest and see all 3 pass

Day 6 of Spec-Driven AI! Next up, Day 7: Make AI Run Tests and Fix Failures.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to build with AI the right way.

#shorts #ai #aicoding #vibecoding #coding #programming #python #promptengineering
tags: how to write better ai prompts
comment: Examples or tests: which do you write first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: make every line in your Done when list something you can check by running it, not a feeling like 'works well'.
